# Black

Black applies a minimalist black interface across Obsidian, which its recorded description ties to high-contrast, distraction-free writing. Backgrounds are deep black and accents stay subtle. Modes, settings and installation details are not recorded beyond that.

![Black screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b3h3m0th/black-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot_512x275.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Black"
    author: "b3h3m0th"
    repo:   "b3h3m0th/black-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "black"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/black"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/b3h3m0th/black-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b3h3m0th/black-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot_512x275.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a minimalist black interface across Obsidian for high-contrast, distraction-free writing. Keep UI elements clean and readable with deep black backgrounds and subtle accents."
}
```
